# Web 4 — agent/1, the agentic internet as open protocols
# agent/1 is the vendor-neutral discovery document at /.well-known/agent through which a website, API or company exposes an authenticated, discoverable, payable machine interface to agents — and through which agents find one.
# The human front door to the stack: the map, the principles, and how a protocol joins.
# No repository on the map is public or launched today; this site makes zero external requests.

## Pages
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/ — the pitch and the nine-layer table, rendered from stack.json.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/stack/ — every layer, its question, its repositories and its status.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/principles/ — the five refusals the estate builds by.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/joining/ — the five-rung ladder a protocol climbs to become a standard.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/why/ — the argument for the stack, layer by layer.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/faq/ — six honest answers, with FAQPage structured data.

## Machine surfaces (byte copies of their sources)
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/.well-known/stack.json — the web4/1 machine twin of the map.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/.well-known/flashyos.json — the flashyos/1 mesh handshake, derived from the AAO charter.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/.well-known/flashyos-charter.json — the AAO charter this org is provisioned from.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/agent-wellknown/.well-known/directory.json — this org's directory/1 node.

The machine twin is maintained at https://github.com/FlashyLabs/agent-wellknown; this repository is https://github.com/FlashyLabs/agent-wellknown.
